bc_reproductive_urgency.definition: The felt push to act on reproduction because the window seems to be closing.
bc_reproductive_urgency.example: The reproductive urgency was real, and the deadline behind it was still unchecked.

detergent.definition: The powder or tablet that does the cleaning. It goes in the main compartment of the drawer, marked with two vertical bars.
detergent.example: Put one tablet in the compartment with the two bars.
